name: Caerphilly Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at various churches across the borough. Open Wed and Sat for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Caerphilly County Borough Allotments
description: Caerphilly County Borough Council manages multiple sites including Abertridwr
image: and Energlyn. Plots from £25/year. Waiting lists for most sites. Contact council for availability.

name: Caerphilly Castle Community Garden
description: Volunteer garden on the approach to Caerphilly Castle growing heritage vegetables and fruit. Surplus produce available to residents during open days. Focus on medieval varieties grown in historical period.
